summary: First test run for JobScope Analytics SPA. Completed end-to-end frontend testing across all 7 pages (Dashboard, Jobs Explorer, Import Data, Insights, Forecast, Skill Gap, About). All required data-testid hooks are present, navigation works, KPI/chart/filter/import/forecast/skill-gap flows behave as expected, theme toggle works, empty state shown, zero uncaught console errors during navigation.

integration_issues.issue: Spec says Data Analyst filter should produce exactly 35 total jobs. First run returned 35 (matches), second fresh run returned 36. Top Roles chart shows Data Analyst=35 in both. Possible non-determinism or a 1-job edge inclusion when filtering. Minor inconsistency, app still functional.

action_items: Investigate Role=Data Analyst total job count (expected 35; observed 36 in one run, 35 in another). Likely a deterministic-but-edge classification difference; align dashboard KPI count with Top Roles chart count.

(Optional) Empty state on Jobs Explorer shows 'No matching jobs / Adjust your search or filters to find postings.' but does NOT expose a dedicated 'Reset' button inside the empty state (Reset Filters lives in the global filter bar). The requirement mentions 'shows an empty-state message with a reset action' — consider adding a reset button inside the empty state for parity.
critical_code_review_comments: Validation errors on manual import form do not appear under standard '.error' selectors; instead a toast 'Please fix the form — Some fields need attention.' is shown. Consider also rendering inline field-level error messages for better UX and testability.
Skill Gap: 'learning-list' element is not rendered until the user adds at least one skill. Consider always rendering the container (empty state) so the testid is consistently discoverable.
All flows are 100% client-side and reset on refresh — behaviour aligns with spec.
seed_data_creation: Imported 1 sample JSON job and 1 manual job during testing; both flows succeeded and redirected to /dashboard with success toast. Data is in-memory; refresh restores 100 seed jobs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is served at preview URL root which auto-redirects to /dashboard. All required data-testids exist. Use playwright with viewport 1920x1080. Each new playwright session is a fresh in-memory store (100 seed jobs, 80 active). Theme toggle adds/removes 'dark' class on <html>. Manual import workmode/experience/status fields are shadcn Select components (buttons with role=combobox), not native <select>; use click + role=option, not page.select_option.
rca of the issue: Data Analyst filter count discrepancy (35 vs 36): the Top Roles bar chart consistently labels Data Analyst = 35, yet the KPI 'Total Jobs' after filtering can show 36. RCA hypothesis: the role-matching predicate used by the filter store may be slightly more permissive (e.g., case-insensitive substring match) than the aggregation function used by the Top Roles chart (exact bucket match). Recommend aligning both paths to the same canonicalRole() helper.
